# Voice Hop

Official website for Voice Hop, a free iPhone and iPad game by Yuanlin Deng.

- Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/voice-hop/id6814815188
- English overview: https://lleryholmesgit.github.io/voice-hop-support/play/
- Resumen en español: https://lleryholmesgit.github.io/voice-hop-support/es/
- 简体中文介绍: https://lleryholmesgit.github.io/voice-hop-support/zh/
- Help: https://lleryholmesgit.github.io/voice-hop-support/
- Privacy: https://lleryholmesgit.github.io/voice-hop-support/privacy.html

## Product facts updated October 8, 2026

Voice Hop records 5–10 seconds of speech or humming. The recording's pitch shapes a jumping course: higher notes make higher terrain, and pauses create safe zones. The player chooses one of three companions and taps or holds to jump while the original recording plays. The voice generates the course before gameplay; the app is not controlled by live shouting. Players can choose to upload a challenge to Apple's CloudKit and send an iCloud link through Messages, Mail, or another service. Sending and accepting a link require active iCloud accounts and Voice Hop. A recipient without the app installs it, then returns to the original message and taps the same link again; installation does not automatically import the challenge. ZIP files are a backup: save the original attachment to Files and import it from Voice Hop. Legacy .vchal files can also be imported from Files. Replay videos are watch-only.

Voice Hop has no ads, in-app purchases, separate Voice Hop account, or developer-operated gameplay server. Recording and level generation happen on-device. Creating an iCloud link uploads the original recording, generated level, display name, and caption to the sender's private iCloud database, using their storage allowance. Anyone with the read-only link and an active iCloud account may receive, save, or forward it. The app refuses new imports after 30 days; cleanup is attempted when the sender next opens the app online in the same iCloud account, not at an exact deadline. The sender can request cloud deletion and stop sharing, completed only after iCloud confirmation. Local originals remain, and recipients' saved copies cannot be guaranteed to be recalled. See the privacy policy for retention and deletion details.

The website includes app-exported replay videos with synthesized test audio and a longer silent simulator screen recording. These demonstrations use debug-only automated jumps, not human play. The released app requires manual touch input for jumps.

For current price, country availability, compatibility, and ratings, consult the live App Store listing rather than treating this file as an automatically updated source.
